We have the procedure documented (see redwood-deletion-policy-2025.pdf attached by Hannah). For a single-thread excision we:
1) Verify thread UID and participants
2) Run scoped ledger removal job to drop traces from the index and telemetry (not model training inputs)
3) Reindex affected segments and generate a deletion manifest
4) Produce an audit artifact (AUD-7764) with signed execution logs for Acme and Redwood legal.

Assumptions / clarifying Qs: do we need to scrub archived exports? If Acme pulled an export already, we can redact the copy in our export store and provide guidance for their local copies, but we cannot modify their local systems.
